content.data: I have been working with Shopify since 2009, shortly after the platform’s launch, building a solid foundation of knowledge across its entire ecosystem.
Over the years, I have developed fully custom themes from scratch as well as extensively customized existing themes to meet specific business needs.

App Development
Custom app creation and third-party integrations.
Beyond themes, I have created new sections and components to enhance existing stores, built custom Shopify apps, and integrated external services through APIs and webhooks.
Store Speed and Optimization
Hydrogen | Headless
I also have hands-on experience with Hydrogen for headless storefronts, combining Shopify Storefront API with modern frameworks to deliver fast and flexible user experiences.
Headless storefront development with Hydrogen v2 (Remix).
Senior Shopify Consulting & Mentoring
JavaScript/TypeScript Development

My JavaScript journey began long before modern frameworks: At **TerraCotta Arte Sacra**, I built a custom ERP integrated with Shopify APIs. Across three major versions, I transitioned from **PHP + jQuery** to **AngularJS**, and finally to a **Node.js + Vue.js full-stack architecture**. This laid the foundation for my deep expertise in integration, API design, and full-stack JavaScript.

At **Decathlon USA**, I further broadened my skills by working with **Vue.js** and **Preact** on specific features, while deeply embedding myself in **React + TypeScript** ecosystems via **Hydrogen v2 (Remix)** and **Next.js**. I also led performance improvements (Core Web Vitals), accessibility (WCAG), and caching strategies for enterprise-scale storefronts.

My personal project, **[Pedro Portfolio](https://github.com/valladao/pedro-portfolio)**, is a **Next.js + TypeScript** application styled with **CSS Modules**, the component-scoped styling approach native to Next.js. This ensures clean, maintainable, and conflict-free styles while keeping performance and accessibility as top priorities.

**In summary:** my JavaScript experience spans over a decade—from ERP full-stack systems to headless Shopify storefronts. Today, I specialize in **React, TypeScript, Hydrogen/Remix**, and modern styling approaches such as **CSS Modules** and **Tailwind CSS**, delivering accessible, scalable, and high-performance frontends aligned with Shopify’s modern stack.
Modern React/TypeScript workflows with a strong emphasis on typed APIs, DX, and measurable outcomes (A11y, SEO, analytics quality).
